additional_concerns: All 12 required pairs are retained. These scoped NOT_APPLICABLE findings do not validate the complete implementations or authorize pruning separate duties.

Footnote 3 is anchored to both XML and prescribed-PDF submissions in da12aecad4e68.u4.1003 and da12aecad4e68.u5.1078. The extraction's absent-anchor uncertainty is resolved. A universal e-Cert requirement, or a general exemption for other methods, is not established.

Registration, XML conformity and e-Cert use are not stated prerequisites to the resubmission trigger. Adding them as trigger conditions would impose unsupported restrictions. Excluding them does not establish submission compliance.

The date-only candidate includes filings before 9:00am on 2 February 2026. The source separately states a calendar-date channel rule and a 9:00am operational launch. Preserve competing interpretations of “following its implementation”; the temporal predicates are not equivalent.

The operational-launch candidates adopt an inclusive 9:00am boundary and require a governing timezone. The packet does not expressly resolve both details. What authoritative time convention or JFIU clarification establishes the timezone and precise implementation boundary? No supplied dependency ID can be reliably mapped to that missing authority.

Direct contact during the blackout does not itself establish an STR submission or create a general post-launch alternative-channel permission. Automatic migration likewise does not establish a new submission event.

Some candidates put actual filing in scope, while node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb puts submission in the result. Nonfiling events can therefore yield OUT_OF_SCOPE versus FALSE; equivalence depends on the admissible event domain.

The history candidate delegates existential event assessment and history completeness to an external Boolean. Missing records cannot justify FALSE without sufficient history. Attribution to the report's responsible entity also needs examination where different entities submitted it.

These questions concern historical triggering. Later resubmission does not erase the trigger, and historical TRUE does not establish an outstanding duty or noncompliance. TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must retain the typed meaning of trigger existence.

JFIU's promised resubmission guidance is absent and has no identifiable dependency mapping. Can its applicable version be supplied for assessment of performance or discharge? Its issuance is not stated as a prerequisite to the duty.
The XML provision separately requires liaison to arrange a technical test. The schema claim is supported as an atomic extraction but does not exhaust the provision.

The four XML-pair disputes remain recorded as unresolved without identified disagreeing dimensions. The assessments below separate support for the duty from availability of the schema; they do not assert that prior disagreement is resolved. All supplied external dependency hashes are null.
